name: TIRZAH
description: Local-first, provenance-aware memory system and governed evidence service for human and agent clients.

name: Preserve trustworthy memory
description: Keep local source material and its provenance inspectable through ingestion, change and reuse.

name: Augment reasoning with bounded context
description: Enable human and AI clients to find relevant, structured, attributable evidence without loading entire corpora.

name: Govern memory across users and time
description: Keep memory access, authority, lifecycle and capabilities controllable as clients and corpora evolve.

name: Attributable source material
description: Ingested text and its source metadata are reproducible and attributable.

metadata.measure: A representative ingestion round-trip preserves exact source text and records its origin and checksum.

name: Evidence survives rebuilding
description: Evidence references retain their meaning across source updates and index rebuilds.

metadata.measure: Rebuild tests never resolve a pinned reference to different canonical text; stale or deleted evidence yields an explicit typed result.

name: Relevant bounded retrieval
description: Questions receive eligible relevant information within declared resource budgets.

metadata.measure: Filter and budget tests return only eligible hits; diagnostics distinguish no matches from degraded retrieval.

name: Verifiable agent evidence
description: Agents can navigate and read complete source evidence associated with their answers.

metadata.measure: An agent reconstructs a long source exactly, follows bounded graph neighbours and cites a stable source revision.

name: Inspectable process
description: Operators can inspect how a question was interpreted, retrieved and passed to a model.

metadata.measure: A completed request identifies selected context, adapter/model, tool actions and failure/omission facts in a human-readable trace.

name: Scoped evidence access
description: Every outward retrieval operation respects authenticated scope and lifecycle eligibility.

metadata.measure: Cross-scope search, node-ID, document and graph reads all deny ineligible evidence without existence leaks.

name: Accountable historical access
description: Superseded evidence is independently governed, and privileged inspection and deletion are attributable.

metadata.measure: Historical access and deletion tests verify distinct grants, complete audit records and fail-closed behaviour.

name: Compatible agent interfaces
description: Clients discover compatible retrieval capabilities and identify incompatible evidence formats safely.

metadata.measure: Mixed-version agents reject unsupported formats and filters with typed errors, without silently relaxing scope.

name: Locally operable memory
description: Local ingestion, retrieval, inspection and recovery remain usable and testable through supported interfaces.

evidence: readme:README.md#Know before you rely on it
metadata.measure: Documented Docker/CLI smoke tests and real-Mongo validation pass in a supported local deployment.

name: Local operator
description: Human who ingests, inspects, reviews and operates the local corpus.

name: Privileged auditor
description: Authenticated human or authorised principal permitted to inspect retained restricted history.

name: Agent consumer
description: Client agent that requests memory capabilities and consumes evidence references.

name: Ingestion pipeline
description: Loads and transforms source material into provenance-aware memory nodes.

name: Memory store
description: Persistence boundary for document, revision, node, tree and graph data.

name: Retrieval service
description: Filtered lexical, semantic, graph and context-building operations.

name: Agent-facing adapter
description: MCP/tool surface translating bounded typed requests to retrieval services.

name: Answer runtime
description: Orchestrates request interpretation, context assembly and response traces.

name: Model adapter
description: Executes local or explicitly permitted model invocations.

name: Authorization gate
description: Server-side authentication, scope resolution and evidence eligibility checks.

name: Audit service
description: Persisted, attributable inspection and retention/deletion event mechanism.

name: Keturah capability registry
description: External capability manifest, discovery and MCP projection system.

name: Local UI and CLI
description: Human-facing operator interface and developer commands.

name: Conformance harness
description: Controlled and real-Mongo tests that verify evidence and adapter contracts.

name: Ingest and preserve sources
description: Load source data, preserve origin, segment deterministically and persist attributable memory.

name: Re-ingest and preserve revisions
description: Associate logical source identity with immutable evidence revisions, recording rebuild lifecycle.

name: Query eligible memory
description: Validate bounded query fields, resolve eligible candidates and rank within the permitted pool.

name: Read exact evidence
description: Resolve pinned source/revision/span and return lossless bounded pages with continuation.

name: Explore hierarchy and graph
description: Traverse memory relationships and document context with fixed eligibility and budgets.

name: Explain context selection and answer
description: Interpret a request, construct context, execute a permitted model and record the trace.

name: Authorize every evidence path
description: Resolve caller identity and effective scope separately from ranking preferences.

name: Inspect and expire retained evidence
description: Use explicitly elevated review paths and attributable retention/deletion authority.

name: Negotiate agent tool contracts
description: Advertise and negotiate compatible capability groups and exact tool contracts.

name: Operate local memory
description: Allow an operator to inspect, ingest, review and recover local memory.

name: Verify retrieval contracts
description: Exercise stable source reads, authorization, mixed clients and recovery on actual storage.

name: Preserve raw source truth
description: TIRZAH SHALL store verifiable original content and attributable origin and checksum metadata without silently replacing it with a summary.

metadata.acceptance: When a source is ingested, exact stored source text and checksum match the original input and provenance is retrievable.

name: Separate source and derived material
description: TIRZAH SHALL distinguish original text, parser output and AI-derived summaries or graph assertions, with provenance for each.

metadata.acceptance: When a generated summary is present, an evidence response can distinguish it from the original source and link it to its inputs.

name: Record chronology separately
description: TIRZAH SHALL store source origin-date evidence separately from ingestion and node creation times.

metadata.acceptance: Given a source authored before ingestion, origin chronology and ingestion chronology are independently retrievable and filtered.

name: Mint stable logical source IDs
description: TIRZAH SHALL mint one opaque logical source identity and use an explicit association rule for rename, updates and path replacement.

metadata.acceptance: A rename preserves source ID, a deliberate update creates a revision, and unrelated same-path replacement is not silently associated.

name: Freeze revision content and map
description: TIRZAH SHALL retain immutable canonical text, transformation fingerprint, revision ID and node-span map while that revision is retained.

metadata.acceptance: Given identical inputs and transformation, repeated runs yield the same fingerprint and spans; changing parser output does not modify earlier revisions.

name: Reject stale evidence resolution
description: TIRZAH SHALL pin references to source identity, immutable revision and exact offset unit, and never silently redirect old references to latest text.

metadata.acceptance: After a rebuild, a pinned read reconstructs original evidence or returns typed stale/not-retained or denied; no substituted text.

name: Expose typed bounded filters
description: TIRZAH SHALL offer typed lexical, vector or hybrid query controls and supported document, label, endorsement and date filters without exposing a free-form database DSL.

metadata.acceptance: Unknown filters are rejected with typed errors; supported filters are applied consistently to all advertised retrieval modes.

name: Resolve eligibility before ranking
description: TIRZAH SHALL filter authorised eligible documents prior to lexical, vector, hybrid or trust-based rank scoring and result truncation.

metadata.acceptance: A higher-scoring out-of-scope hit is absent in each retrieval mode even if its endorsement or trust value is maximal.

name: Provide deterministic cursors
description: TIRZAH SHALL bind page tokens to scope, query, ordering and corpus snapshot, with explicit invalidation after incompatible changes.

metadata.acceptance: A modified snapshot or scope causes a typed stale-cursor error rather than mixing results or widening scope.

name: Report search degradation
description: TIRZAH SHALL return structured diagnostics for unavailable semantic adapters, time budgets, omissions and true empty result sets.

metadata.acceptance: An unavailable semantic adapter produces a typed degraded/unsupported result, not a false semantic zero-result success.

name: Read verbatim source pages
description: TIRZAH SHALL return bounded exact canonical source slices with source ID, revision ID, offset unit, has_more and continuation.

metadata.acceptance: An agent concatenates pages of over 16,000 characters, preserving whitespace and Unicode exactly.

name: Carry source provenance
description: TIRZAH SHALL attach immutable source and revision identity, origin, content hash and distinction between cited source and interpretation to each read.

metadata.acceptance: A search result provides sufficient fields to read and cite the same source span without another fuzzy lookup.

name: Validate read authorization
description: TIRZAH SHALL independently authorize direct node, source and revision reads even if callers supply previously seen identifiers.

metadata.acceptance: A caller given a restricted node ID cannot retrieve its text or infer its existence through direct read.

name: Bound graph exploration
description: TIRZAH SHALL enforce per-hop, depth, branching and total-result caps, with typed edge and direction filters.

metadata.acceptance: Traversing a cyclic graph terminates within declared caps and reports omitted/limited results.

name: Exclude restricted graph neighbours
description: TIRZAH SHALL apply authorization at every traversal expansion and return no restricted neighbours or existence leaks.

metadata.acceptance: When a graph edge enters a restricted domain, the result omits forbidden node and edge details and reveals no sensitive metadata.

name: Build source-bound context
description: TIRZAH SHALL construct context packages with citations and budget limits, keeping generated interpretations subordinate to source.

metadata.acceptance: A question needing several documents returns source-specific provenance and indicates omitted or insufficient evidence.

name: Expose human-readable execution trace
description: TIRZAH SHALL record retrieval choices, query steps, used context, adapter/model handoffs and substantive failures.

metadata.acceptance: After a request, an operator can inspect a readable log identifying source selections and the answer model.

name: Authenticate identity and corpus scope
description: TIRZAH SHALL resolve actual caller identity and effective authorized corpus scope server-side before any evidence retrieval.

metadata.acceptance: A forged identity or trust parameter never changes the server-resolved accessible corpus.

name: Keep endorsement separate from authorization
description: TIRZAH SHALL use trust and endorsement only for ranking within the permitted evidence pool, never for access rights.

metadata.acceptance: A high endorsement value cannot make an otherwise unauthorized memory eligible in any adapter.

name: Protect every outward endpoint
description: TIRZAH SHALL apply eligibility checks to search, list, read, graph and historical paths regardless of discovery metadata.

metadata.acceptance: Direct-ID, alternate adapter and cross-domain requests all fail closed without authorization bypass.

name: Distinguish evidence lifecycle states
description: TIRZAH SHALL hold supersession and approval status separately from immutable evidence, with explicit authority to inspect each state.

metadata.acceptance: Superseded evidence is excluded from ordinary retrieval; permission to inspect it does not grant rejected/pending access.

name: Audit privileged disclosure
description: TIRZAH SHALL write an attributable actor, scope, reason, target revision and outcome audit record for every privileged inspection; fail closed on mandatory audit failure.

metadata.acceptance: Simulated audit-store outage prevents privileged disclosure and the event is not falsely reported as recorded.

name: Authorize retention deletion independently
description: TIRZAH SHALL require separately attributable authority and an auditable event for expiry or deletion, without implying indefinite retention.

metadata.acceptance: An unauthorized deletion request fails; authorized deletion records policy/actor/reason and subsequently prevents disclosure of expired content.

name: Advertise versioned capability groups
description: TIRZAH SHALL publish supported search, read, graph and historical interaction-group versions through Keturah-compatible manifests.

metadata.acceptance: An agent can discover which mutually compatible capability group versions can safely be used in a session.

name: Verify individual tool contracts
description: TIRZAH SHALL expose an exact schema/semantic fingerprint for each tool and reject unsupported contract uses explicitly.

metadata.acceptance: An agent whose requested tool fingerprint is unsupported receives typed incompatibility, not silent field omission.

name: Carry evidence compatibility metadata
description: TIRZAH SHALL embed evidence-format and minimum required capabilities in immutable references so mixed-version consumers detect mismatches.

metadata.acceptance: Agent B consuming an Agent A reference either resolves it with compatible semantics or returns a typed incompatibility error.

name: Remain operable locally
description: TIRZAH SHALL support locally bounded ingestion, queries and inspection without making remote hosting mandatory.

evidence: readme:README.md#Know before you rely on it
metadata.acceptance: A documented local Docker/CLI workflow ingests a source and retrieves inspectable context without requiring cloud services.

name: Preserve backward compatible interfaces
description: TIRZAH SHALL provide a documented additive transition for existing CLI, MCP and local operator consumers.

evidence: readme:README.md#Know before you rely on it
metadata.acceptance: Existing search-memory clients continue working or receive an explicit versioned migration path with contract tests.

name: Test with real Mongo and rebuilds
description: TIRZAH SHALL verify lifecycle, exact evidence, history, audit, graph bounds and authorization using real Mongo alongside unit tests.

metadata.acceptance: Real-Mongo test matrix covers full and diff rebuild, direct-ID bypass, historical audit failure and multi-page reconstruction.

name: Block insecure network exposure
description: TIRZAH SHALL treat authenticated scope enforcement and operator-API security issue 18 as deployment prerequisites, not advisory flags.

evidence: readme:README.md#Know before you rely on it
metadata.acceptance: Deployment conformance fails when an unauthenticated operator endpoint or insecure externally exposed memory API is enabled.

name: Immutable evidence identities
description: Stable source identity, independently minted immutable revisions and pinned offsets are required for exact evidence.

name: Versioned agent compatibility
description: Use Keturah capability groups and exact tool contracts; references express format prerequisites; discovery never authorizes access.

name: Governed historical disclosure and deletion
description: Separate immutable evidence, mutable lifecycle, privileged inspection authority and attributable expiry/deletion authority.

name: Source truth outranks summary
description: Original source and provenance shall remain distinguishable from all model-generated interpretations.

name: Eligibility precedes scoring
description: Authorization and status gating must run separately from trust and endorsement ranking.
